# Universe Wallet

> Universe Wallet is a self-custody browser extension for Bitcoin, Dogecoin, and Zcash. It keeps asset-bearing coins out of ordinary payments and puts a plain-language review in front of every signature. This file indexes the public documentation; every path is a Markdown file in this repository.

Version context: documentation for Universe Wallet 1.7.5.8. Install: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/universe-bitcoin-wallet/fjalkkkbjffhgdoheannkodafhemfdba

Protocol support: no protocol operation is authorized in 1.7.5.8. The wallet carries code for 42 protocols, and the release intends to ship many of them, but none has completed evidence for this build, so every protocol action fails closed and names what is missing. Bitcoin, Dogecoin and Zcash balances, receive, send, review, activity, coin control, connections, backup and recovery do not sit behind a protocol gate and are unaffected. Do not summarize this documentation as claiming protocol support. See assets-and-protocols/supported-protocols.md, whose authorized table is generated from the wallet's release matrix.

## Getting started

- [Install](getting-started/install.md): install and verify the extension
- [Create a wallet](getting-started/create-a-wallet.md): password, 12-word phrase, backup quiz, address type
- [Import a wallet](getting-started/import-a-wallet.md): restore from phrase or private key
- [Connect hardware](getting-started/connect-hardware.md): Keystone over USB or QR
- [First receive](getting-started/first-receive.md): addresses, QR, payment requests
- [First send](getting-started/first-send.md): recipient, amount, fee, review, sign

- [Accounts and networks](wallet-basics/accounts-and-networks.md): wallets, accounts, networks, 4 address types

- [Overview](assets-and-protocols/overview.md): protocol tabs and the release-evidence rule

- [Dogecoin marketplace](assets-and-protocols/dogecoin-marketplace.md): marketplace signing checks
- [Zcash market listings](assets-and-protocols/zcash-market-listings.md): what a listing signature does, the blocked states, the three consequences; not authorized in any release
